calls.title: Growthbook <> NovaKid - Intro
calls.summary: NovaKid (Vyacheslav Ryabukhin, technical lead, and Michael Lisovski, manager) discussed their need for advanced GrowthBook features like prerequisite feature dependencies and sticky buckets, which are missing in their current self-hosted setup. GrowthBook reps Daniel Wathne and Ryan McGurk explained enterprise pricing ($83/user/month + 20% platform fee) and proposed a tiered model with power and light users for the ~25-30 NovaKid team members. Next steps: Daniel will send a proposal with different user tier
